# Sell all 200.00 USD the book holds after a 100.00 USD invoice was overpaid
# with 200.00 USD: 100 against the invoice's own cost basis, carried at 1.40,
# and 100 against the asset cost basis the bank's split opened for the dollars
# that arrived with the overpayment, at the payment's 1.37 (Q-054). The cost
# consumed is 140.00 + 137.00 = 277.00 CAD, and the sale's proceeds of 290.00 CAD
# leaves $residual$ booking a 13.00 CAD gain.
#
# The customer's credit is a liability cost basis, owed rather than held, so
# no sale of dollars held draws on it.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_foreign_currency_cost_basis.py.
2026-03-01 * "Sell 200 USD"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Bank:USD -100.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "1.40"
		value: "-140.00"
		cost_basis_split_guid: "{basis_a}"
	Assets:Bank:USD -100.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "1.37"
		value: "-137.00"
		cost_basis_split_guid: "{basis_b}"
	Assets:Bank 290.00 CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
		share_price: "1"
		value: "290.00"
	Income:FX Gain $residual$ CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
